verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no general public REST/GraphQL API reference. Thoropass does document an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant drive the workspace: list audits and evidence requests, view details, and add comments, attachments and status updates, with configurable tool limits. That gives AI-native users a documented programmatic interface, but it is an agent-scoped tool surface rather than a full public API. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API with endpoint reference, API authentication/key docs, coverage beyond audits and evidence requests (controls, policies, risks, monitors), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
